content.comment_body: Hello, is there a way to prevent the default menu from showing on the [product_name] Operator Device? Specifically, I'd like only my custom menu created with signaling texts to be visible, without the default options like I/O status, date/time, and parameter settings.

I'm not sure I fully understand your question. Are you trying to hide the initial menu level? If so, that's not possible. Alternatively, if you're asking how to restore the default menu after it's been changed, you can do so by pressing the cursor down until you're back in the original menu.
Yes, I want to hide or set a password for the initial menu level. Is there any way to do this?

analysis.insight_summary: A user wishes to customize the interface on a [product_name] Operator Device by hiding or restricting access to the default menu, but discovers that this isn't feasible. This highlights a current restriction regarding interface customization and user access control for this device, which may impact scenarios that require dedicated or secured menus.
analysis.user_expectations: User anticipates being able to disable or password-protect the default menu on the [product_name] Operator Device, displaying only their personalized interface.
